entities.name: Piperazine substrate
observations: Decoded as N-methyl carbamoylmethyl piperazine, approximately CNC(=O)COC(=O)N1CCNCC1; contains a secondary piperazine nitrogen available for alkylation.

entities.name: Bromoethyl aryl ether
observations: Decoded as 1-chloro-4-(2-bromoethoxy)benzene, approximately ClC1=CC=C(OCCBr)C=C1; the primary alkyl bromide is the expected leaving group while aryl chloride is retained.

entities.name: Piperazine N-alkylation
observations: Likely SN2 substitution: the secondary piperazine nitrogen attacks the terminal 2-bromoethyl group, forming a C–N bond and expelling bromide; the aryl C–Cl bond is not the reacting site.

entities.name: K2CO3 in MeCN
observations: Directly matching empirical record supports potassium carbonate as base and acetonitrile as solvent, commonly with heating for this N-alkylation.
